english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday Cantonese expression for making harsh breathing noises while asleep.

examples.english: I snore in my sleep all the time, so the person in the next room can't sleep.
examples.traditional: 我瞓覺時成日打鼻鼾，搞到隔籬房嘅人都瞓唔着。
